stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: Who is on the Gannet tonight?

stations.title: Evening lists
stations.text: Blank lines, stray spaces, names all apart

stations.title: Harbour office
stations.say: Every boat and its names. Thanks!

captions: The quay in the evening. Ossian needs each boat's passengers for the harbour office.
Today the list is full of blank lines and spaces, and a boat's names are all apart.
You tidy the list where it is, add up each boat's seats, and gather each boat's names.
Now the Gannet's passengers arrive together, in the order they booked.
Clean lists and full maps, a rule at a time. Next: asking a list for answers.
